question: A town in west yorkshire on the river aire home to a rugby league team?
text: **Castleford** (10 letters). It’s a West Yorkshire town on the River Aire and home to the Castleford Tigers rugby league team. ([experiencewakefield.co.uk](https://experiencewakefield.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Experience-Wakefield-Visitor-Guide-2023.pdf?utm_source=openai))
